May 26, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy
Oakmont Corp increased its stake in Boeing Co (BA) by 232.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oakmont Corp bought 218,489 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.82% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 312,368 shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $92.12 million, up from 93,879 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oakmont Corp who had been investing in Boeing Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $211.45 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.30% or $1.09 during the last trading session, reaching $360.09. About 2.46M shares traded. The Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) has risen 82.35% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 70.80% the S&P500.
